revision_note: The original affine line sections retain their old finite presentation and flatness. Maximal localization, finite flat local freeness, and the original local-to-global projectivity theorem derive projectivity. The actual finite free retract supplies finitely many maps to and from R whose sum is the original identity. Applying the original tilde functor and specified canonical tilde-Gamma counit gives actual sheaf maps through the structure line whose sum is the identity of the SAME original line. Forgetting scalar multiplication retains these maps and identity. Original Ext composition and finite-sum identities then transfer the existing structure-sheaf local H-prime degree-one vanishing to the original additive line sheaf on every affine open of Spec(domain R). No global line trivialization, free rank-one basis, line cohomology vanishing assumption, or abstract replacement cohomology carrier is used. The full chart-family finite identity is proved rather than assumed. Still separate: local cohomology transport from the global Contact line to its actual chart restrictions, the original derived Mayer-Vietoris comparison with the constructed Laurent cokernel, uniform family bounds, Riemann-Roch and actual Jacobian representation. All sources are hosted-pending; copied predecessors have only their separately recorded validated frontier. No local Lean compilation.
